title: Bioluminescent Jellyfish
subtitle: Harmonic Umbrella Kinematics & Phosphor Pulse
description: Marine cnidarian hydrostatic locomotion modeled via periodic radial bell contractions and multi-node sinusoidal wave propagation down trailing tentacles.
mathNotation: R(\theta, t) = R_0 \left[ 1 + A \sin(\omega t) \cos(n \theta) \right], \quad y_{\text{tentacle}}(s, t) = s + A_t \sin(k s - \omega t)
formulaCompact: r_dome = R*(1 + 0.22*sin(3t)),  y_tentacle = y0 + s + sin(3t - 6s + k)*18s
